property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() on the correct contract either reverts for non-owners or leaves owner unchanged only when caller is owner; the mutant that removes the require allows non-owners to call owned() without revert which can change/leave owner differently — so the invariant is: only the owner can successfully call owned() (non-owners cannot).
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove require), so owned() can be called by non-owners and thus owner may remain unchanged when called by non-owner versus original revert.
